blocks.text: MANILA – The House of Representatives prosecution panel expects the Senate impeachment court to hand down a decision on the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Z. Duterte by late November or early December. “Inaasahan po natin, kung isa na lang ‘yung article na pag-uusapan, sana po by end of November, or at least, at the latest, first week of December, sana makapagdesisyon na po (We anticipate that if there is only one article left to discuss, a decision could hopefully be reached by the end of November, or, at the very latest, by the first week of December),” House prosecutor […]...
